status: Incomplete preliminary accounting for C14_traceable_mg996r_ovonic; not Chief selection, procurement authorization, budget compliance or physical acceptance.
accounting_notes: Prices, original currencies (AUD or USD), tax bases, dates and supplier limitations remain in the named price inputs and must be retained by the audit output. This manifest does not re-fetch or alter them.
Budget currency is AUD; enforce vehicle cost strictly less than 500, excluding tax and shipping. Charge complete sales units, not installed fractions; no ownership credits.

Purchase quantities are candidate planning quantities, not orders. A minimum_purchase_units value of 1 is a provisional one-sales-unit assumption unless the cited evidence establishes otherwise; checkout minimums remain unverified.

Installed quantities describe the candidate architecture, not an assembled vehicle. Null means unknown, never zero. Material consumption includes cutting waste, supports and fabrication losses when subsequently established.

Mass values are dated supplier claims or explicitly conservative choices, not measurements. An omitted mass tolerance is not evidence of zero uncertainty. The calculator's installed_mass_upper_kg label means only nominal plus recorded allowance, not a guaranteed physical upper bound.
Full two-battery pack cost is charged while only one battery contributes flight mass. Bearings, straps, pads, resistors, jumpers and fasteners retain their pack semantics.

Shared stock and kit contents must be allocated once. Do not charge included motor mounts, propeller adapters, adapter rings or linkage-kit fasteners again; confirm their adequacy and installed mass coverage.

The eight fastener packs and thirty separate nuts are retained candidate assumptions, not a CAD-derived schedule. Do not interpret their aggregate stock counts as proof that the required lengths and interfaces are available.

AUD 20 contingency is an allowance, not a purchased component and not proof that listed omissions are covered. When gaps are priced, retain explicit accounting rather than silently spending or double-counting contingency.
gse_lines is empty because no separately priced GSE ledger has been established. It does not mean zero GSE cost or existing ownership. Vehicle and GSE completeness remain false.
The gimbal, servo, controller and sensing entries remain alternatives awaiting current Chief selection. No current mechanism decision or human review acceptance is implied.

RPM measurement, inline electrical power measurement, voltage/current meters and motor/ESC/battery temperature measurement equipment.
Assembly mass scale and equipment for CG/inertia and actuator travel/backlash measurements.
